body:
By default, I would map <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> on Windows/Linux and <kbd>Meta</kbd> on macOS only. Otherwise, if you try to use an unrelated shortcut on Windows/Linux after toggling freelook, the camera will go downwards for no apparent reasons (e.g. <kbd>Meta + 2</kbd> to open the second pinned taskbar application, or <kbd>Meta + E</kbd> to open a file explorer).

I'm not sure if `.macos` shortcut overrides are followed by the 3D editor freelook code though.

These are only active when right-click is held, so it is not possible to accidentally move the camera down when not holding right-click.

For Meta on Windows/Linux: The OS shortcuts take precedence, like pressing Meta by itself opens the Windows Start menu, kicking anyone out of freelook. I can remove this for Windows/Linux, sure, but I did it this way initially to keep the bindings consistent between platforms, since it's harmless to have the binding if users use Ctrl instead.

For Ctrl on macOS: I really think this one should stay bound. Games that use Ctrl on Windows/Linux use Ctrl on macOS as well. Command on macOS is for copy/paste/etc, but it is not a 1:1 replacement for Ctrl.
I updated the PR to just use Ctrl always.
